description: This file contains implementation of DNS record data parsing and handling, including classes for different DNS record types such as SRV, A, AAAA, CNAME, PTR, TXT, NSEC, and their associated methods for creation, comparison, and validation.

classes.name: RecordRdata
classes.description: Base class for DNS record data types with validation method.

classes.name: SrvRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS SRV record data, including priority, weight, port, and target.

classes.name: ARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents IPv4 DNS A record data.

classes.name: AAAARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents IPv6 DNS AAAA record data.

classes.name: TxtRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS TXT record data, including multiple text strings.

classes.name: NsecRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS NSEC record data, including bitmap for DNSSEC.

methods.name: HasValidSize
methods.description: Checks if the data size is valid for a given DNS record type.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create DNS record data objects from raw data and parser.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the DNS record type identifier.

methods.name: IsEqual
methods.description: Compares two DNS record data objects for equality.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Checks if a specific bit is set in the NSEC bitmap.
